description_en: Queries the invitation status of customers who have been registered and invited
description_zh: 查询已报备已发出邀请客户的邀请状态
name: GetInviteStatus

fields.help_en: The invitation ID. Obtained from the InviteSubAccount operation
fields.name: invite_id

Code.description_en: The status code. Error code value: 3057: InviteId is empty
Code.description_zh: 状态码  错误代码值: 3057: InviteId为空

Code.description_en:
The result code. Valid values:
200: OK.
1109: System error
Code.description_zh:
结果码
取值范围:
200 OK
1109 系统错误

InviteStatusList.description_en: The invitation record status result list

AssociationSuccessTime.description_en: The time when the distribution customer account was successfully associated with the distributor account. This value is empty if no association exists
AssociationSuccessTime.description_zh: 分销客户账户成功关联分销商账户的时间。如果没有关联则为空

Cid.description_en: The CID of the distribution customer

GmtCreate.description_en: The time when the invitation email was sent

ParentId.description_en: The UID of the distributor to which the distribution customer account belongs
ParentId.description_zh: 分销客户账户所属分销商UID

Status.description_en:
The invitation status. Valid values:
0: The registration URL has not been visited.
1: Registration failed.
2: Registration succeeded.
3: The registration URL has been visited but the form has not been submitted
Status.description_zh:
邀请状态:
0 未访问注册URL
1 注册失败
2 成功注册
3 已访问注册URL但是没有提交表单

SubAccountType.description_en:
The account type. Valid values:
1: Agency end customer.
2: Reseller end customer.
5: Reseller tier-2 partner
SubAccountType.description_zh:
账户类型:
1 Agency的终端客户
2 Reseller的终端客户
5 Reseller类型2级伙伴

Uid.description_en: The UID of the distribution customer
